name: Physical Paysend Mastercard
summary: A legacy physical plastic card for global ATM withdrawals and point-of-sale transactions, currently serviced for existing holders only.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required
Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the Physical Paysend Mastercard charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Physical Paysend Mastercard?
faq.answer: It charges about 2% on non-base-currency spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the Physical Paysend Mastercard require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
